profile: Storytel AB is a Swedish digital platform and publishing group that provides subscription streaming for audiobooks and e-books under the Storytel and Mofibo brands. It operates in more than 25 markets and also runs a publishing business through imprints including Norstedts, StorySide, Printz Publishing, People’s Press, Rabén & Sjögren, B. Wahlströms, Gummerus and Lind & Co.
